description: 국가철도공단_공항철도자기부상_역위치 [railways and stations and airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 데이터 항목에는 철도운영기관명, 노선명, 역명, 경도, 위도가 포함되어 있으며, 이를 통해 지도 기반 시각화, 공항 내 이동 경로 최적화, 실시간 위치 안내 시스템 구축 등 다양한. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 위도, 자기부상, 위치 경도, 자기부상 역 위치. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
